verdict.rationale: Adyen's own APIs let integrations run without the Customer Area UI. The Terminal API drives payments and refunds via JSON messages, and the Management API automates terminal management through API requests instead of the Customer Area. A basic testing system simulates transaction scenarios before going live. However, nothing documents running the product in CI, and the physical test card implies hands-on terminal testing. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline usage, a terminal-free simulator suited to automated test runs, an official CLI or headless tooling, independent corroboration of automated test workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Management API lets you order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location of your choice using API requests instead of the Customer Area.

We provide a basic testing system to simulate transaction scenarios and functionalities. You can use this system to ensure your test integration is working as expected, before you switch to an integration that can make live transactions.
The Adyen Terminal API lets you make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information, and perform other shopper-terminal interactions using a payment terminal supplied by Adyen.
